messages:
chloe (AE): Heads upAcme POC had a burst that produced 5xxs during a rehearsal. Demo tomorrow AM. Can we swarm?
jamal (SE): Copy. region/pool + any request ids?
chloe (AE): Hosted us-west1, pool=acme-poc. Devon shared ids: acme-20260401-1, acme-20260401-2. Burst profile: steady ~45 RPS, spikes to 120 for ~20s.
devon (customer): Yep. Test harness is parallel curl blasts from CI.
alex (SRE): Short host logs: 
[2026-04-01T18:15:10Z] r=acme-20260401-1 status=503 reason=queue_overflow queue=605 limit=600
[2026-04-01T18:15:11Z] r=acme-20260401-2 status=502 reason=kernel_oom host=gpu-12
autoscaler-bot: scale_event triggered=true reason=queue>threshold current=605 threshold=600 target_replicas=6 start=2026-04-01T18:15:12Z ready=2026-04-01T18:16:00Z
maria (Eng): Two concurrent failure modes: backlog + a transient kernel OOM. Fast mitigations: 1) enable model fallback to a lower-memory variant 2) bump min_replicas to keep warm capacity 3) route bursts into burstpool if enabled.
jamal (SE): Also ask customer to add client jittered backoff for 5xx/429. Small example: `retry(){ curl -s $URL || (sleep $((RANDOM%3)); retry); }` Exponential jitter recommended.
alex (SRE): I will: set min_replicas=3 for acme-poc, enable routing.fallback=[redwood-medium], and spin 3 warm burstpool instances. Applying now.
alex (SRE): Done. Logs: `set min_replicas=3; fallback=redwood-medium; burstpool warm=3 ready`. Cleared queued requests.
devon (customer): Re-running ramp now (starting 18:16 PT). Will report after ~90s.
jamal (SE): Also turned off `prefer_region` override so model fallback is prioritized instead of region failover.
maria (Eng): Filing INF-6482 to investigate autoscaler cold spin-up latency and kernel memory peaks.
alex (SRE): Collected /var/log/redwood/hosts/gpu-12/oom.log and attached to ticket.
devon (customer): Rerun looks stable: a couple early 503s, then steady. p50 ~82ms, p95 ~420ms. Demoable.
chloe (AE): Awesome. Post-demo follow-ups: recommend default POC config: pre-warm min_replicas, enable model fallback, add burstpool for demos, and include client retry sample in docs.
jamal (SE): I'll add a short runbook snippet and sample code to the POC playbook.
chloe (AE): Thanks team  I'll update the deal thread and schedule a quick retro with Acme after the demo.
